source_record.title: Data release for GWTC-5.0: Tests of General Relativity

decisive_reasons: The release contains pSEOB, QNMRF and ringdown-pipeline products, not production-linked evidence for the exact frozen GWTC-4 pyRing endpoints.
No asset satisfies the frozen exact P02 alias requirement.
No asset directly establishes common declared P02 support for a qualifying endpoint pair.
No asset instantiates the frozen 22 D05 pyRing base/variant pair set.
Inferring support from sample extrema, physical domains or software defaults is forbidden by the frozen B04 contract.
future_watch_condition: Only new official public production-linked run-level evidence giving exact chi_f field semantics, unit, prior bounds/common support and pre-value pair provenance could justify considering a separately versioned preregistration; historical B04 remains unchanged.
